label: CMWSSB Citizen's Charter 2021, PDF copy (page references are to that copy, printed from cmwssb-dev.interlaceindia.com). Verify against the official site cmwssb.tn.gov.in before any official use. This project is not affiliated with CMWSSB.

stage_labels.depot: Depot Engineer or Senior Accounts Officer

escalation_rule: The charter gives the number of days for each level (p. 4). It does not state whether these days are cumulative from registration or apply to each level separately. If not solved, a notification goes to the Chief Engineer (p. 4).

owners.depot: Depot Engineer or Senior Accounts Officer at the depot

water_leakage.label: Water leakage in a pipe
water_leakage.charter_row: Complaint regarding leakage in main (p. 4, section C): service line 3, distribution main 5, transmission main 7. All three are shown in the PDF copy.
water_leakage.fix_note: Shown in the PDF copy (p. 4, section C). Verify against the official site cmwssb.tn.gov.in before any official use.

water_pollution.label: Contaminated or polluted water
water_pollution.charter_row: Complaint regarding pollution (p. 4, section C): point easily identified 7; otherwise 15

no_water_supply.label: No water or defective water supply
no_water_supply.charter_row: Attending no water supply / defective water supply (p. 4, section C): 5

defective_meter.label: Defective water meter
defective_meter.charter_row: Replacement of defective water meter: 7 (p. 4, section C). Shown in the PDF copy.
defective_meter.fix_note: Shown in the PDF copy (p. 4, section C). Verify against the official site cmwssb.tn.gov.in before any official use.

handpump_repair.label: Hand pump repair
handpump_repair.charter_row: Attending repairs (p. 4, section C): hand pump 2; India Mark pump 5

sewer_main_blockage.label: Sewer main blockage
sewer_main_blockage.charter_row: Blockage of sewer line (mains) (p. 4, section D): 4

damaged_sewer_line.label: Damaged sewer line
damaged_sewer_line.charter_row: Repair to damaged sewer line / renewal of sewer line (p. 4, section D): 20

tax_charges.label: Tax and charges
tax_charges.fix_note: The charter gives no maintenance timeline for tax and charges. The escalation matrix applies (p. 4).
tax_charges.charter_row: Grievances related to tax and charges (p. 4, section F): 2 days at each level

tanker_supply.label: Mobile (tanker) water supply
tanker_supply.fix_note: Charter (p. 4, section E): tanker supply within 24 to 48 hours of booking under normal conditions. The escalation matrix applies to grievances.
tanker_supply.charter_row: Supply of water through water tankers on booking (p. 4, section E): 24 to 48 hours; grievances (p. 4, section F): 2 days at each level

new_connection_delay.label: Delay in new water or sewer connection
new_connection_delay.fix_note: Charter (p. 3): house service connections within 15 days from registration on its merits.
new_connection_delay.charter_row: Effecting house service connections (p. 3): within 15 days from registration; grievances (p. 4, section F): 7, 4, 3, 2 days

street_water_no_piped.label: Free street water where no piped supply exists
street_water_no_piped.fix_note: Charter (p. 4, section E): free street supply through a water tanker within 4 hours of complaint. The charter gives no escalation matrix for this service.
street_water_no_piped.charter_row: Supply of water on non-receipt of piped water supply (p. 4, section E): within 4 hours of complaint

septic_tank_clearance.label: Septic tank clearance
septic_tank_clearance.fix_note: Charter (p. 4, section E): clearance within 10 days from booking. The charter does not name an owner for this service; the depot is assumed.
septic_tank_clearance.charter_row: Septic tank clearance (p. 4, section E): 10 days from booking

unsafe_cleaning.label: Unsafe sewer or septic cleaning
unsafe_cleaning.fix_note: Routed to the 14420 national helpline (p. 6, section 6.8). The charter gives no timeline for this complaint type.
unsafe_cleaning.charter_row: National helpline 14420 for unsafe septic tank and sewer cleaning (p. 6, section 6.8)

general_grievance.label: General grievance or complaint
general_grievance.fix_note: The charter gives no timeline for grievance cell handling (p. 6, section 7). A human must set the deadline.
general_grievance.charter_row: Grievance Cell registers general grievances (p. 6, section 7); no timeline given
